description: Read the member's most recent laboratory results, grouped as the source groups them, keeping every value, unit, date and message. The result carries one `ref` for the whole latest-results view: pass it to maccabi_detail with any group_values[].test_id for that analyte's history, which can reach further back than this list, or to maccabi_document for that analyte's own attached result. maccabi_report returns the whole latest-results PDF. Paging selects groups, not individual rows. This is not a complete history.
name: maccabi_latest_labs
